observations: Photo 0: Alternator unit shown on a brick wall; pulley/drive end visible; multiple mounting points and electrical terminals present.
Photo 1: Close-up of the alternator’s rear/electrical side with cooling vents and internal copper windings visible through an opening.
Photo 2: Close-up of the alternator’s side with electrical connector ports and the drive pulley shaft end.

claims.claim: Direct Tokunbo Valeo Alternator for Mercedes-Benz M278 - 439741
claims.evidence: No readable Valeo logo/part number or M278-specific marking is visible in the provided photos; the text is from the seller.

claims.claim: Alternator is for Mercedes-Benz M278 (engine code) and part number 439741
claims.evidence: Photos do not show a clearly readable engine-code/part-number label that matches 439741 or M278.

risks.risk: Wrong alternator fitment (different Mercedes engine/alternator variant) despite similar appearance.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the alternator label/part number plate (including Valeo/OEM number) and the connector type; also ask for the exact Mercedes model/engine it was removed from.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used alternator with unknown compatibility (worst case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Not working / weak output (seller didn’t provide test proof).
risks.proof: Ask for a video of the alternator being tested (bench test or installed test) showing voltage/current at idle and at higher RPM.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: treat as not working).

risks.risk: Internal damage not obvious from photos (burnt windings, worn bearings, diode failure).
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up of the rear bearing area and a test result (AC ripple/diode test or bench test report).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially faulty until tested.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/incorrect mounting hardware (brackets, pulley, regulator, mounting bolts).
risks.proof: Ask what exactly is included (pulley, regulator, mounting brackets/bolts) and request photos of all included parts laid out.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the alternator’s identification label/part number plate (Valeo/OEM number) and any barcode/sticker.
Video or screenshot of alternator test results (bench test or installed test) showing output voltage/current.
Photo of the pulley/drive end and confirmation of included mounting brackets/bolts and connector type.
Exact vehicle details it came from (Mercedes model + engine code) to confirm M278 compatibility.
response.reason: The photos show an alternator, but they do not provide readable Valeo/OEM identification or M278/part-number confirmation, and there is no test proof. Without that, a worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct unit.
